consent_statement: I have read the above. I consent to my adoption being recorded permanently and publicly on the ledger as described.
note: Preserved verbatim, and never to be edited: any consent record referencing this version must remain readable against the exact words it was given. Superseded because one sentence was wrong — it described the ledger record as 'cryptographically signed', but an adoption record carries a recomputable hash and no signature; signatures belong to Foundation attestations, which are a separate layer. Version 1.1 corrects that sentence and explains that copies cannot be recalled because the record is public.
